decisions.reason: The illuminated candle arch builds directly on the firm's arch and lighting craft knowledge, so management can read its sales results and refine it within existing capabilities.
A one-tier Christmas pyramid is core Erzgebirge-style workshop know-how, giving strong absorptive capacity to learn from its results and improve it.

The electronic music box lies outside the firm's woodworking knowledge, and with no in-house R&D the electronics are hard to assimilate, but its home-page prominence suggests continued investment for now.
This electronic motif platform is distant from the firm's craft base and appears only as a peripheral mention, so the firm lacks the related knowledge to interpret its results and improve it.
This Christmas motif accessory for the electronic music box has a weak knowledge fit and low visibility, and the released resources would be better spent on core pyramids and arches.
The Dresden-themed pyramid extends the firm's established pyramid expertise with regional motifs, a fit that makes learning and improvement straightforward.
